_comment: The Mutopia candidates of the L1 plan (docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-14-l1-curated-library.md, section 'Candidate list'): every row of both Mutopia tables, the 76 main candidates and the 21 spares, in the plan's order. Tasks 13 to 18 write their catalog.d fragments from these facts.

Planned fields (Task 3, Step 1): slug; task (the implementer, 13 to 18); level (the planned level); collection (an id from catalog.json's collections); spare; ftpDir (the Mutopia ftp directory, the same path as in the mirror research/data/mutopia_src/ftp); mutopiaId; expectedLicense (the licence in the mirror's header, written as the RDF text; the fetched RDF is authoritative); convert (catalog convert options known in advance, else null).

Written back by 'fetch_mutopia.py --candidates content/tools/candidates.json' after the fetch: rdfLicense, lyFile, maintainer, lilypondVersion (from the fetched RDF, via build.rdf_info); lyFiles (only when lyFile is a -lys.zip: the files it contains); midiFiles (the published MIDI files, as paths relative to ftpDir; '<name>-mids/<file>' for files extracted from a -mids.zip); pdfPages (page objects in the fetched A4 PDF(s); null without a PDF); mainSha256 (SHA-256 of the fetched lyFile); mirrorMatch (whether the fetched source is byte-identical to the mirror's copy; null when the mirror or the mirror's copy is absent); excluded (the reason, only for a licence outside public domain, CC BY and CC BY-SA).
